10 REM KONSOL BBC BASIC Z80 - CARTESIAN GRAPH20 DIM V%(60),U%(60)30 REPEAT40 PRINT50 PRINT "KONSOL GRAPH: Y=A*X*X+B*X+C"60 PRINT "1 X^2   2 2X^2   3 X^2+3"70 PRINT "4 X^2-4X+1   5 -X^2   6 CUSTOM"80 PRINT "0 EXIT"90 INPUT "SELECT 0-6: ",M%100 IF M%=1 THEN A=1:B=0:C=0110 IF M%=2 THEN A=2:B=0:C=0120 IF M%=3 THEN A=1:B=0:C=3130 IF M%=4 THEN A=1:B=-4:C=1140 IF M%=5 THEN A=-1:B=0:C=0150 IF M%=6 THEN INPUT "A = ",A160 IF M%=6 THEN INPUT "B = ",B170 IF M%=6 THEN INPUT "C = ",C180 IF M%>=1 AND M%<=6 THEN GOSUB 1000190 UNTIL M%=0200 END1000 PRINT1010 PRINT "A=";A;" B=";B;" C=";C1020 PRINT "* = CURRENT, . = REFERENCE X^2"1030 PRINT "X: -6 TO +6; Y: -10 TO +10"1040 FOR I%=0 TO 601050 X=(I%-30)/51060 Y=A*X*X+B*X+C1070 Z=X*X1080 V%(I%)=99:U%(I%)=991090 IF Y>=-10 AND Y<=10 THEN V%(I%)=INT(Y+0.5)1100 IF Z>=-10 AND Z<=10 THEN U%(I%)=INT(Z+0.5)1110 NEXT I%1120 FOR R%=10 TO -10 STEP -11130 L$=""1140 FOR I%=0 TO 601150 S$=" "1160 IF R%=0 THEN S$="-"1170 IF I%=30 THEN S$="|"1180 IF I%=30 AND R%=0 THEN S$="+"1190 IF U%(I%)=R% THEN S$="."1200 IF V%(I%)=R% THEN S$="*"1210 L$=L$+S$1220 NEXT I%1230 PRINT RIGHT$("   "+STR$(R%),3);" ";L$1240 NEXT R%1250 PRINT "LEFT=-6, CENTRE=0, RIGHT=+6"1260 RETURN9000 REM
